summary: Pin sits beside the Fernhouse in the botanic gardens; footpaths only, no parking.
reasons: Garden paths only, no vehicle access

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by garden buildings and visitor paths; not secluded.

drivers.traffic: Visitor attraction with foot traffic all day.
drivers.convention: Botanic garden; no sign of overnight stays.

Pin is on managed gardens near a pond
